summary: A flat-to-soft open is likely as October begins, with Gift Nifty just below Wednesday's close and traders cautious ahead of a holiday break.

detail.leaders: Autos in focus on September sales, oil marketers
detail.tone: After three straight losing sessions to close September, the setup is subdued; most Asian markets are lower and Gift Nifty points to little change.
watch: Auto sales prints through the day

top.title: FIIs sell ₹10,148 cr; DIIs buy ₹11,272 cr
top.line: Foreign selling stayed above ₹10,000 cr on the month's last day; DIIs absorbed all of it
more: FII gross purchases ₹14,968 cr vs sales ₹25,116 cr
DII gross purchases ₹24,414 cr vs sales ₹13,142 cr

top.title: US PCE inflation cools more than expected
top.line: Headline PCE slowed to 3.4% and core to 3.0%, both below forecasts
more: The S&P 500 still fell 0.25% and the Dow 0.86%; the Nasdaq rose 0.24%
The S&P had been up nearly 0.7% intraday before fading

top.title: September auto sales roll in today
top.line: Maruti, M&M, Tata Motors, Bajaj and TVS report volumes; festive demand is in focus
more: A favourable year-ago base could flatter growth numbers
Several carmakers have announced price increases

top.title: Brent near $97 as supply worries linger
top.line: Brent rose about 1% to $97.09 on Wednesday; US-Iran talks remain unresolved
more: The rupee was near ₹95.97/$ on Wednesday
Oil marketers and refiners are in focus

top.title: Markets shut Friday for Gandhi Jayanti
top.line: Thursday is the last session before a long weekend, which may cap fresh positions
more: The RBI MPC begins its meeting on Oct 5; the rate decision is due on Oct 7
